qaScope: read-only native victory/condition metadata/counts and metric limitations
warnings: Base matrix132 and supplemental28 are distinct. Supplemental seeds/gear/constellations were purpose-selected and cannot be pooled into unbiased win-rate averages or a general character rarity verdict.
Native H.play reward victory, finishBattle win, raw victory flags and first/three-win sequences agree. These outcomes do not depend on the damage accounting caveat.

H.observe ownDamage/allyDamage records per-applyDamage outer HP net decline plus shield decline; heal-before-hit can change net loss. Chasm/Dendro campaign outgoing totals have no packet-to-native-log/pre-hit HP reconciliation comparable to boss C0 QA. Do not label those totals verified true damage or infer exact damage superiority from them.

Chasm damageLogTotalToAllies (formerly hpDamageToAllies) is instead an unbounded sum of native log.damage, not the outgoing net meter. Native log.damage can include overkill; this summary did not cap every packet to actual pre-hit HP. The provided bounded-log diagnostic is not a replacement fully reconciled damage meter.
Dendro reaction damage includes full hit for amplification/additive reactions and separate packet for transformative reactions; the totals cannot all be called pure reaction bonus damage.

Actual initial Lv25/phase2 is observed; old legal phase1 prose and Traveler C3 E+3 prose were corrected in metadata. Traveler native C3 buffs Q; initial companion levels/gear are diagnostic assumptions, not a recovered user save.
Native XP and level-up full healing carry between fights. Three wins without inn therefore does not imply three fights without any native healing.
Public WAIT60min is a natural encounter witness, not measured travel or farming time. Diagnostic ownership/gear/acquisition time excluded.
Pilot compressed data are preserved as an artifact but excluded from completed aggregate counts.
No new runtime experiments or product, DB, Git, or documentation changes.
